apps.description: Private, native Android email client for JMAP and IMAP/SMTP, FOSS, no Google services, no tracking.
apps.releaseNotes:
S/MIME

- An encrypted S/MIME message is decrypted with a certificate from Android's keystore, on JMAP and IMAP. Unlock opens Android's certificate picker; the chosen certificate is kept for that account, and later messages decrypt on opening when their source can be downloaded. Cancelling leaves the message locked. A message not encrypted for that certificate says so and offers to pick another. The private key stays in the keystore, and the decrypted text stays in memory. A message signed then encrypted has its inner signature checked too (#238).
